title: Molecular AOP Builder: curator-in-the-loop mapping of AOP Key Events to WikiPathways, Gene Ontology and Reactome

creators.name: Martens, Marvin
creators.affiliation: Department of Translational Genomics, Maastricht University

description:
A curator-in-the-loop web application for building molecular Adverse Outcome Pathways — the layer connecting the Key Events of an AOP to the molecular pathways and processes that underlie them.

Candidate WikiPathways pathways, Gene Ontology Biological Process and Molecular Function terms, and Reactome pathways are ranked by BioBERT semantic similarity to the Key Event. A curator assigns a confidence level through a structured rubric, and an administrator approves each mapping before it enters the public REST API. Approved mappings are exportable as GMT (for fgsea and clusterProfiler), RDF/Turtle with full curation provenance, CSV and JSON, and are consumed downstream by the Molecular AOP Analyser.

This record archives the application source code, under GPL-2.0-only. The curated mapping dataset it produces is a separate Zenodo deposit with its own concept DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.20184643, released under CC0 1.0 — except Key Event titles, which are reproduced from AOP-Wiki under CC BY-SA 4.0. Cite the software if you ran, self-hosted or extended the application; cite the dataset if you analysed the mappings.

A live instance runs at molaop-builder.vhp4safety.nl.

Funding. Part of the VHP4Safety project, funded by the Dutch Research Council (NWO, ROR 04jsz6e67) under the Netherlands Research Agenda: Research on Routes by Consortia programme, grant NWA-ORC 1292.19.272.
